name: cruciblebox
description: CrucibleBox extensible toolbox built with Tauri
author: cruciblebox

scripts.build: npm --prefix tauri-frontend run build && npm run verify:tauri-version
scripts.release: npm run check && npm run build
scripts.release:validate: npm run verify:tauri-version && npm run verify:tauri-runtime
scripts.release:dir: npm run build && npm run package:dir
scripts.typecheck:scripts: node --check eslint.config.mjs && node --check scripts/build-release-manifest.mjs && node --check scripts/collect-release-artifacts.mjs && node --check scripts/spawn-file.mjs && node --check scripts/db-recovery-tool.mjs && node --check scripts/backup-tauri-db.mjs && node --check scripts/verify-clean-checkout.mjs && node --check scripts/plugin-artifact-provenance.mjs && node --check scripts/packaged-paths.mjs && node --check scripts/sign-plugin-artifacts.mjs && node --check scripts/verify-plugin-release.mjs && node --check scripts/generate-sbom.mjs && node --check scripts/generate-release-checksums.mjs && node --check scripts/verify-windows-update-artifacts.mjs && node --check scripts/audit-workspaces.mjs && node --check scripts/run-format.mjs && node --check scripts/clean-all.mjs && node --check scripts/verify-tauri-version-alignment.mjs && node --check scripts/tauri-version.mjs && node --check scripts/smoke-windows-installer.mjs && node --check scripts/smoke-tauri-installer.mjs && node --check scripts/smoke-release-transition.mjs && node --check scripts/verify-tauri-runtime-assets.mjs
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:node && npm run typecheck:renderer && npm run typecheck:test && npm run typecheck:scripts
scripts.test: npm run test:host && npm run test:supply-chain && npm run test:next
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test
scripts.package:base: node scripts/verify-tauri-runtime-assets.mjs --staged --profile=base . && cd src-tauri && cargo tauri build --config tauri.base.conf.json
